title.zh: v2.1.20 手机端（M6）：探索——底鼓设计 / 和弦走向 / 律动解构，并为横屏重排
title.en: v2.1.20 Phone (M6): 探索 — Kick Design, Progressions, Groove Layers, and a Landscape Layout

highlights.zh: **探索模块三个子页，每个都真的能做点什么**：**底鼓设计**（SUB/THUMP/CLICK 三层开关、柔软度/砂砾感/内脏压力三档手感、四个策展预设，点一下即发声）、**和弦走向**（按类别浏览策展走向，点播放按它自己的调性与风格试听）、**律动解构**（把当前曲风的四轨摊开，点一轨就把它从正在播放的循环里拿掉，图案即时重发给引擎，下一小节就听得到）。
highlights.en: **Three sub-pages that each do something**: **kick design** (the SUB/THUMP/CLICK layers, the softness/grit/sub-weight feel values, and the four curated presets — one tap and it sounds), **progressions** (browse the curated progressions by category and audition one in its own key and feel), and **groove layers** (the current genre's four lanes laid out; tap a lane to drop it out of the loop that is playing — the pattern goes back to the engine and the next bar is missing that…

highlights.zh: **没有从桌面搬过来的**：手机版不再提供「载入工作台」与自制底鼓预设的保存/删除。两者都需要一个「工作台」作为落点，而手机上有工作台入口的模块自己就够了；两个会悄悄替换用户当前作品的按钮，比没有按钮更糟。
highlights.en: **Left behind from the desktop**: 载入工作台 (bake to the workspace) and saving/deleting custom kick presets. Both need a workspace to write into, and on a phone the module that owns the workspace has its own entry point; two buttons that silently replace what the user is working on are worse than no buttons.

highlights.zh: **横屏是净新增设计**：参考稿完全没有方向处理（固定 432 px 单列），所以本轮为短而宽的视口加了媒体查询——列表与控制在横屏并排成两列、内容封顶到视口高度，**并且是量出来的**：E2E 在竖屏量到 1 列、把视口转成 844×390 后要求量到 **2 列**（这正是单测看不见的那类东西；也顺带证明没有横向溢出）。
highlights.en: **Landscape is new design**: the reference has no orientation handling at all (a fixed 432 px column), so this round adds a media query for short, wide viewports — lists and controls sit side by side in two columns and the content is capped to the viewport height. It is **measured**, not asserted: the E2E leg measures one column in portrait, then switches the viewport to 844x390 and requires **two** columns (exactly the kind of thing a unit test cannot see), and checks there…
